subjPresentPerfect.es: No creo que hayan vivido allí mucho tiempo.
subjPresentPerfect.en: I don't think they've lived there very long.

subjPluperfect.es: Si hubieras vivido en los años ochenta, te encantaría esa música.
subjPluperfect.en: If you had lived in the eighties, you'd love that music.
